title: Scandinavian Defense
intro: Black answers 1.e4 with 1...d5 at once and takes back with the queen. Simple to learn and solid, with a clear plan.

lessons.title: The main line with Qa5
lessons.summary: Hit e4, take back with the queen, then tuck it on a5.

steps.text: 1...d5 attacks the e4 pawn straight away. After 2.exd5 Qxd5 the queen is out early, and 3.Nc3 chases it with tempo.
The queen goes to a5: away from the knight, out of the centre, and still eyeing e1 and the knight on c3. Then Black develops with ...Nf6, ...c6 and ...Bf5, a sturdy position with an easy plan.
Play the main line as Black.
steps.hint: d5, take back with the queen, then queen to a5, knight to f6 and pawn to c6.
steps.ifRight: That is the Scandinavian main line. Next comes ...Bf5 and ...e6.
